supersedes_before_implementation.reason: V1 froze the scientific representation, targets, controls, fit budgets, audit geometry, gates and branches but left restart initialization, the stationary-control restart count, exact Rodrigues zero handling, scalar inverse update semantics and report identity implicit. No operator code, fit, report, metric or result existed.

implementation_constants.rodrigues_numpy: if angle equals exact zero return identity; otherwise K=skew(w/angle), Q=I+sin(angle)K+(1-cos(angle))K^2
implementation_constants.bounded_rotation_torch: norm=l2(raw); ratio=tanh(norm)/norm with exact polynomial limit 1-norm^2/3 selected below 1e-8; w=maximum_angle*ratio*raw
implementation_constants.projection_bounds: componentwise minimum and maximum of corners multiplied by Q
implementation_constants.curve_endpoint_canonicalization: stored controls set first=0 and last=1 after fit; exact identity operator returns a copy before Bernstein evaluation
implementation_constants.nonfinite_policy: raise before serialization and record no formal report

candidate.restart_0: rotation raw and all curve logits exact zero

positive_matrix_curves.restart_0: curve and matrix logits exact zero; alpha_logit=-4.0

fit_semantics.stationary_objective: existing cube_diffeomorphic_colour_flow v1 objective with frozen coefficient and smoothness regularizers
fit_semantics.gradient_clip: apply after backward and before optimizer step
fit_semantics.stationary_projection: clamp coefficients only to the frozen plus/minus coefficient bound after every optimizer step
fit_semantics.best_restart_rule: minimum final regularized objective then lowest restart index
fit_semantics.identity_target: construct exact candidate/global/positive identities and exact zero-velocity K3; never optimize identity

inverse_semantics.strength_1: multiply output by Q, normalize with frozen cube projection bounds, invert each scalar curve, denormalize, multiply by Q transpose

scalar_curve_inverse.update: if curve(midpoint) < target_value set lower=midpoint else set upper=midpoint

inverse_semantics.partial_strength_policy: raise; partial strength is audited only as a forward path

target_and_audit_semantics.target_hash_validation: validate both v1 source config hashes before constructing any target
target_and_audit_semantics.target_generation: use existing operator_from_config and positive_film_operator_from_config with the exact v1 witness and strength fields
target_and_audit_semantics.target_prerequisites: all target outputs on the v1 cube and Jacobian geometry must be finite, inside the v1 numerical cube rails and have positive finite-difference determinants before fitting
target_and_audit_semantics.finite_difference_columns: channel order 0,1,2; central difference; stack as Jacobian output-row by input-column
target_and_audit_semantics.red_ramp_luma: dot output RGB with exact v1 luma coefficients
target_and_audit_semantics.strength_order: distance from identity must be nondecreasing in exact listed strength order for every nonzero-distance row
